ModMetaData.name: Facial Hair Placement
ModMetaData.author: Burnwick
ModMetaData.description:
Adjust where beards and other facial hair are drawn on pawns.
Open Options > Mod options > Facial Hair Placement to move facial hair with X and Y sliders. Front, side and back views each have their own sliders (west mirrors east automatically). When a save is loaded, the settings window shows a live preview on your pawns.
Safe to add or remove at any time.
